claim: A finalized thread document's capture-provenance note must not assert coverage the embedded body lacks: it states the exact last turn the body covers and never claims the close turn or any later turn is present when it is absent. The finalized body is a frozen snapshot bounded by the render's previous-completed-turn horizon, so any completeness claim is scoped to that horizon. This is the backstop that keeps the artifact truthful even when /end is run inline against a render frozen at the previous completed turn - the fold-chronicle close overstated its coverage by one full topic, which this note prevents.

evidence.detail: Operator decision in the end-skill round-trip session (2026-07-03): even with the turn-separation rule, the thread document's provenance note must state the true coverage boundary and never overstate.
